name: garnet-runtime-review
description: Record CI job connections and their execution chains, then retrieve runtime evidence when reviewing pull requests

setup.notice: Recording needs a supported Linux CI job. Public repository profiles need no login; private profiles require Garnet device authorization.
steps: Install the Garnet GitHub App on the repositories where you want pull request comments.
Ask Devin to add Garnet Runtime Review to your repository's CI using the bundled install skill.
